title: Luna's Player Notes
description: With this fabric mod you can add notes to players that will appear next to their name!
body:
This mod allows you to set notes on players! The notes will appear next to their name.

# HOW TO USE

- "N" is the default keybind to open the menu
- press the player that you want to give a note
- enter the note in the field (if you enter nothing, it will remove the note)
- it will appear!


**IMPORTANT: THIS MOD DOES NOT WORK ON CERTAIN SERVERS LIKE PVPCLUB FOR SOME REASON!!!**
